pontos: Creates Propag, a program to review the debts of states and the Federal District to the federal government
Covers debts entered into under laws of 1993 and 1997 and complementary laws of 2017, 2021 and 2023
Includes debts linked to Provisional Measure No. 2.192-70 of 2001
Provides for the creation of a federative equalization fund
